_comment: Problems check-previews finds in cms/previews.js that already existed when the guard was added. New ones fail; an entry whose problem has been fixed must be removed (it fails as unused). kind live-html: text typed into the CMS reaches the preview as live HTML. kind undefined-text: a half-filled entry makes the preview print the word undefined.
